decisive_items: He was diagnosed with severe malnutrition and received blood transfusion; parenteral nutrition (500 kcal/day); fluids; electrolyte, trace-element, and multivitamin supplementation
Then he acutely developed profound fatigue and flaccid weakness of all four limbs.
response.rationale: Severe malnutrition followed by nutritional replenishment and acute profound hypophosphatemia with flaccid weakness is classic for refeeding syndrome.
